svg.aria-label: An agent pipeline: a request passes an input guard to an orchestrator that plans, routes and retries; the orchestrator reaches for allow-listed tools, a cited vector store and scoped memory; a model answers; an output guard applies policy; the answer is recorded in an audit trail. Switching scenarios marks where production strikes it and what catches it.

g.text: one path, one time, in front of an audience
a name, an NRIC, a salary
on its way out of the region
the bill arrives, and it is
the same call ten thousand times
route to the small model · cache · cap
